themes.note: Light values live on :root and dark values on [data-theme="dark"] in src/app.css. Frontmatter keys suffixed -dark are the dark-theme values of the same CSS custom property. The rail (--sidebar-bg = --brand-navy) does not change between themes.

shadows.name: omnibox-focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Signature lit state of the link box; paired with outline: 2px solid var(--accent) at -1px offset.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on buttons, links and selects; on accent-filled elements the ring becomes 2px var(--secondary) at +2px.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Omnibox glow (0.25s), download key press (0.15s), monogram hover (0.2s), lockup entrance (0.6s).

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Download key and idle rail tabs on press.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Accessibility setting; the lockup entrance also honors prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Resting control: mist fill, hairline stroke, 12px corners.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 5h-2a2 2 0 0 0 -2 2v12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2v-12a2 2 0 0 0 -2 -2h-2"/><path d="M9 3m0 2a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v0a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-2a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2z"/></svg>Colar</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); background: var(--button, #eaeef6); color: var(--button-text, #17223f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--button-stroke, rgba(11,21,48,0.07)) inset; font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--button-hover, #e1e7f2); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--button-press, #d8e0ee); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0062e6); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Button, active
components.description: Selected state of a button: the one live thing in its group.
components.css: .ds-btn-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); background: var(--accent, #0062e6); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faff); font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-active:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #0057cc); } .ds-btn-active:focus-visible { background: var(--accent-press, #004db5); outline: 2px solid var(--secondary, #0b1530); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Omnibox with download key
components.description: Signature: the link field lights up on focus; the download key is a filled accent key.
components.css: .ds-omnibox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; max-width: 640px; padding: 0 5px 0 12px; background: var(--popup-bg, #fbfcff); border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); outline: 1.5px solid var(--input-border, #b4bfd4); outline-offset: -1.5px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(11,21,48,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), outline-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-omnibox-icon { color: var(--gray, #56627d); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-omnibox:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0062e6); outline-offset: -1px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft, rgba(0,98,230,0.1)), 0 12px 32px -14px var(--accent-glow, rgba(0,109,255,0.28)); } .ds-omnibox:focus-within .ds-omnibox-icon { color: var(--accent, #0062e6); } .ds-omnibox-input { flex: 1; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--secondary, #0b1530); font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-omnibox-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray, #56627d); } .ds-download-key { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--border-radius, 12px) - 4px); background: var(--accent, #0062e6); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faff); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -6px var(--accent-glow, rgba(0,109,255,0.28)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-download-key:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #0057cc); } .ds-download-key:active { background: var(--accent-press, #004db5); transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-download-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary, #0b1530); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail tab
components.description: Sidebar tab on the brand-navy rail; the selected tab is a full accent block with glow.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 80px; padding: 4px; background: var(--brand-navy, #0a1633); } .ds-rail-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 3px; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); color: var(--sidebar-highlight, #e9eef8); opacity: 0.75; font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-rail-tab:hover { opacity: 1; background: rgba(233,238,248,0.08); } .ds-rail-tab:active { transform: scale(0.95); background: rgba(233,238,248,0.14); } .ds-rail-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0062e6); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rail-tab-active, .ds-rail-tab-active:hover { opacity: 1; background: var(--accent, #0062e6); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faff); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px var(--accent-glow, rgba(0,109,255,0.28)); }

components.name: Big switcher
components.description: Segmented choice in a mist trough; the selected segment is an accent block.
components.css: .ds-switcher { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3.5px; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); background: var(--button, #eaeef6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--button-stroke, rgba(11,21,48,0.07)) inset; max-width: 572px; } .ds-seg { flex: 1; height: 33px; padding: 0 9px; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--border-radius, 12px) - 3.5px); background: transparent; color: var(--button-text, #17223f); font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg:hover { background: var(--button-hover, #e1e7f2); } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0062e6); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-seg-active, .ds-seg-active:hover { background: var(--accent, #0062e6); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faff); }

components.name: Settings subnav tab
components.description: Settings list row; idle tiles stay neutral, the selected row gets an accent-soft fill, accent stroke and accent tile.
components.html: AparênciaVídeo
components.css: .ds-subnav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 250px; } .ds-subnav-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 12px); color: var(--button-text, #17223f); font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; text-decoration: none; } .ds-subnav-tab:hover { background: var(--button-hover-transparent, rgba(11,21,48,0.06)); } .ds-subnav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0062e6); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-subnav-icon { display: flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--button, #eaeef6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--button-stroke, rgba(11,21,48,0.07)) inset; color: var(--gray, #56627d); } .ds-subnav-active, .ds-subnav-active:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(0,98,230,0.1)); color: var(--secondary, #0b1530); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent, #0062e6) inset; } .ds-subnav-active .ds-subnav-icon { background: var(--accent, #0062e6); color: var(--white, #f8faff); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Status tile
components.description: Brand status glyph used in dialogs and empty states; error variant swaps accent for red.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--accent, #0062e6); background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(0,98,230,0.1)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--button-stroke, rgba(11,21,48,0.07)) inset; } .ds-tile-error { color: var(--red, #e0263b); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red, #e0263b) 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a console that lights up, the way the blue S in the PSDev logo glows out of navy. A navy rail holds the frame in both themes; inside it, a calm field of cool ink-blue neutrals carries one centered link box. When the user focuses that box or pastes a valid link, it lights in electric blue and the download button becomes a filled blue key. Everything else stays quiet so that lit state reads instantly.

Density is low and task-first: one column, a 640px field, a short row of controls, and plain Portuguese copy in sentence case. Depth comes from accent glow, not from grey drop shadows. The brand lives in exact details: the logo lockup above the field, the monogram atop the rail, the blue focus ring, the press scale on the key.

The world refuses cobalt's grey monospace minimalism and the generic white SaaS card. Neutrals are never pure black or pure white; every grey is tinted toward navy.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail (brand navy) in light and dark themes alike; content surface switches with the system theme.
Electric blue marks only the current/on state of a control, the focus ring, and the valid-link download key.
Sora Variable for every piece of UI text; IBM Plex Mono only inside code, pre and kbd.
12px corners on every control and container; nested controls step down to 8px.
The omnibox focus glow is the signature.

rules.name: The One Live Thing Rule
rules.body: Electric blue marks only the current or on state of a control, the focus ring, and the download key. Within any one control group, at most one element is blue. Idle tiles, idle tabs, headings, links and surfaces stay neutral.

rules.name: The Navy Rail Rule
rules.body: The rail is brand navy in both themes. It does not invert with the theme; only the content surface does.

rules.name: The No Pure Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward navy. Pure #000 and #fff do not appear.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: All UI text is Sora. Mono appears only for code-like content (code, pre, kbd); filenames and data may use it, labels and buttons never do.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Copy is PT-BR sentence case ("Cole o link aqui", "Serviços compatíveis"). No uppercase labels, no letter-spaced overlines.

rules.name: The Glow Is Blue Rule
rules.body: If something casts light, it is live and the light is accent-glow. Neutral elements get a hairline stroke, not a shadow.

dos: **Do** keep electric blue on one live element per control group: selected tab, selected segment, selected subnav tile, focus ring, enabled toggle, download key.
**Do** keep the rail brand navy in both themes and put the PS monogram at its top.
**Do** use 12px corners, stepping nested controls down by their inset (8px for the download key).
**Do** express lift as accent glow, and only on live elements; use 1px inset hairlines for everything else.
**Do** use Tabler outline icons at stroke 1.5-2.2 (2.2 on the download key, 1.5 in dialogs and tiles).
**Do** write PT-BR sentence case, and make errors say what happened and what to try next.
**Do** derive any new brand raster from `logopsdev.png` and record its provenance here.
donts: **Don't** use blue for idle tiles, headings, body links or surfaces.
**Don't** use pure #000 or #fff; pick the tinted neutrals.
**Don't** set UI labels or buttons in mono, or set any text in a face other than Sora outside code.
**Don't** use uppercase or letter-spaced labels above headings.
**Don't** add grey drop shadows to cards or containers.
**Don't** reintroduce cobalt's name, logo, or mascot anywhere except the About credit.
**Don't** generate or redraw the logo; use the derived rasters.
